home.welcome: Create an instance to get started. Each instance runs isolated with its own mods, worlds and settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.debugLoggingHint: Writes verbose logs. Takes effect after a restart.
settings.telemetry: No telemetry: MehburMC Launcher sends no usage data.
settings.curseforgeKeyHint: Your own key (console.curseforge.com) for installing CurseForge modpacks (.zip). Stored on this computer only.
settings.launchBehaviorHint: With "Close", the launcher quits once the game reaches the main menu; the game keeps running (play time is not recorded for that session).
settings.defaultMemoryHint: Instances without their own setting use {{gb}} GB.
settings.concurrencyHint: Files downloaded at the same time (1–32).
settings.moveBusy: Finish running games and downloads first.
settings.moveBack: Move back to the default location
settings.portableHint: Portable mode: data lives in the MehburMC folder next to the exe.
settings.moveConfirm: All game files, instances and caches will be copied to this folder, verified and deleted from the old location. The folder must be empty. Settings and accounts stay where they are.
settings.moving: Moving… Do not close the launcher.
settings.moved: Move complete. Restart the launcher to use the new location.
settings.movedLeftovers: Move complete; {{n}} old file(s) were in use and could not be deleted — remove them later. Restart the launcher.

startup.title: The launcher could not start
startup.hint: The data folder could not be created or is not writable. Check folder permissions or run the launcher in portable mode (portable.flag next to the exe).

paths.noDataDir: Could not determine the user data folder.
paths.notWritable: The data folder is not writable: {{path}}
paths.moveFailed: Could not move the data folder: {{reason}}

net.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your internet connection.
net.notAllowed: Security: blocked an address that is not on the allowlist: {{url}}
net.tooLarge: The server response is unexpectedly large: {{url}}

download.hashMismatch: The downloaded file is corrupt (checksum mismatch): {{path}}

version.notFound: Minecraft {{version}} was not found (if you are offline, install it once while online).
version.invalid: The version file for {{version}} is invalid: {{reason}}

java.unavailable: Java {{major}} cannot be downloaded automatically for this system ({{os}}/{{arch}}).

archive.unsafe: Security: the archive contains an unsafe entry ({{entry}}): {{path}}

auth.invalidName: Invalid player name "{{name}}": 3–16 characters, letters, digits and _ only.

launch.commandTooLong: The command line is too long for Java {{major}}.

account.none: Add or select an account first.
account.nameTaken: This username is taken. Please choose another one.
account.nameLimit: At most 10 usernames can be reserved from this computer. Delete an account you no longer use.
account.nameCheckOffline: An internet connection is needed to check the username.
account.nameServiceUnavailable: The username service is unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.

loader.optifineInvalid: This file is not an OptiFine jar: {{path}}
loader.optifineMissing: The OptiFine {{mc}} {{edition}} jar has not been imported. Pick the jar again in the instance settings.

content.curseforgeKey: A valid CurseForge API key is required for this modpack (Settings → Advanced).

friends.unavailable: The friends server is not accepting new identities right now. Please try again later.
friends.codeNotFound: That friend code was not found.
friends.self: You cannot add your own code.
friends.notFriends: You are not friends with this person.
friends.rateLimited: You are sending messages too fast; wait a moment.
friends.messageInvalid: Messages cannot be empty and are at most 2000 characters.
friends.listNotFound: This mod list is no longer shared.
friends.badItem: The list contains an invalid file.

server.notFound: Server not found in the list (it may have changed; refresh).
server.listInvalid: Could not read the game's server list ({{path}}): {{reason}}
server.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
server.badResponse: No Minecraft server answers at this address (or it is a very old version).

instances.emptyBody: Create your first instance and pick its version, RAM and Java.
instances.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently, including its worlds and mods.

instance.repairHint: Verifies every file with SHA-1 and re-downloads broken ones.

options.javaHint: Automatic: the Java version required by the game is downloaded and used.
options.jvmArgsHint: Separate with spaces; quote values that contain spaces.

files.modsHint: Use "Add content" to install mods from Modrinth.
files.screenshotsHint: Press F2 in game to take a screenshot.
files.deleteWorld: The world "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

console.emptyHint: When you start this instance its output streams here live.

downloads.emptyHint: File downloads appear here when you start an instance.

accounts.removeBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the list.
accounts.renameHint: The new name shows in game from the next PLAY.
accounts.nameServerNote: The name is registered on the MehburMC server so it stays unique among all MehburMC users.
accounts.nameConflict: Another user has this name — rename

loader.optifineOtherVersion: The chosen jar is for Minecraft {{jar}}; this instance is {{mc}}.
loader.forgeHint: The installer runs on first launch (patches the vanilla jar); this can take a few minutes.
loader.legacyFabricHint: For old versions Fabric does not support (1.3 – 1.13.2).
loader.optifineHint: OptiFine has no download API and forbids redistribution: choose the jar you downloaded from optifine.net. To use it with Forge, put the jar into the mods folder.
loader.changeWarning: Existing mods may not work after changing the loader. The new loader is installed on the next launch.

shaders.title: Shader support
shaders.body: Installs Iris + Sodium (with required dependencies) from Modrinth into the mods folder.
shaders.bodyForge: Installs Oculus + Embeddium (with required dependencies) from Modrinth into the mods folder.

browse.needsLoader: This instance has no mod loader. Choose Fabric, Forge, … in its settings to install mods.
browse.noCompatible: No version is compatible with this instance.
browse.removeTitle: Are you sure you want to delete it?
browse.removeLocked: Cannot be deleted while the game is running.

content.emptyHint: Use "Add content" to install from Modrinth, or copy files into the folder.

modpack.blockedBody: Their authors disabled third-party downloads. Download them from the page and put them into the shown folder.

skins.noAccount: Create an account first to assign skins.
skins.noSkin: No skin selected — the default skin is used in game.
skins.appliedTo: Showing {{name}}'s skin. Click a card to preview it.
skins.emptySkinsHint: Add a 64×64 or 64×32 PNG, pick a preset or design your own skin.
skins.emptyCapesHint: Add a 64×32 cape PNG, pick a preset cape or design your own.
skins.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted from the library and removed from accounts using it.

inGame.title: Show in game
inGame.body: Launcher skins are invisible in the vanilla game. In instances with the CustomSkinLoader mod, the launcher hands the selected account's skin and cape to the game every time you press PLAY.
inGame.noModded: You have no Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge instance. Create one to see your skin in game.
inGame.vanillaNote: In Vanilla, OptiFine and Legacy Fabric instances the skin only shows in the launcher preview. Other players only see your skin if they also run CustomSkinLoader and have the same file.
inGame.syncNote: The skin is refreshed on every launch; restart the game after changing it.

presets.gameDefaultsHint: Read from the installed {{version}} game files.
presets.noDefaults: Download a Minecraft Java version first to see the default skins (launching any instance once is enough).
presets.collectionHint: Drawn for the launcher; click to preview, + to add to your library.

editor.title: Design
editor.hint: Left click: draw · Right click: erase · Alt+click: pick colour

crash.title: {{name}} crashed
crash.exitCode: The game closed unexpectedly (exit code {{code}}). Likely causes:
crash.unknownHint: Check the last errors in the console and the crash report. Disabling the most recently added mod often reveals the culprit.

outOfMemory.title: Out of memory
outOfMemory.hint: The game used up its RAM. Increase memory in the instance settings (6–8 GB for modpacks) or remove heavy mods.

heapReserve.title: Could not reserve RAM
heapReserve.hint: Java could not reserve the requested memory. Lower the RAM setting or free up system memory.

javaTooOld.title: Java is too old
javaTooOld.hint: This version or mod needs Java {{detail}}. Set Java to "Automatic" in the instance settings and the launcher downloads the right one.

javaTooNew.title: Java is too new
javaTooNew.hint: Old Minecraft/Forge versions need Java 8. Set Java to "Automatic" or pick Java 8.

missingDependency.title: Missing dependency
missingDependency.hint: A mod needs another mod that is not installed. Install it (often Fabric API / Architectury / GeckoLib) from the Mod Browser.

incompatibleMods.title: Incompatible mods
incompatibleMods.hint: Some mods cannot run together. Disable or update one of the mods named below.

duplicateMod.title: Mod installed twice
duplicateMod.hint: The mods folder contains the same mod more than once. Delete the old copy.

mixinFailure.title: Mod conflict (Mixin)
mixinFailure.hint: A mod failed to patch the game, usually a version mismatch or two mods clashing. Update or remove the named mod.

missingClass.title: Incompatible mod version
missingClass.hint: A mod tried to use code that does not exist in this Minecraft/loader version. Make sure your mods are built for it.

graphicsDriver.title: Graphics driver problem
graphicsDriver.hint: OpenGL could not start or the driver crashed. Update your GPU driver from the vendor; on laptops make sure the game runs on the dedicated GPU.

nativeCrash.title: Java crashed
nativeCrash.hint: The Java VM died with a native error ({{detail}}). Update drivers; try again with shader/performance mods disabled.

corruptFile.title: Corrupt file
corruptFile.hint: A jar/zip file looks damaged. Use "Repair" to verify game files; if it is a mod, download it again.

update.autoHint: Looks for a new launcher version at startup. Updates are signed and verified.

status.upToDate: The launcher is up to date.
status.unavailable: Update channel unreachable (offline or no release yet).
status.portable: Portable copies do not update themselves; install the new version with the setup file from GitHub.

friends.consentBody: To chat with friends and share mods, the launcher creates an anonymous identity for you on the MehburMC server (Supabase). No e-mail or password needed.
friends.consentStored: Stored on the server: your friend code, display name and profile photo (your selected account's name and photo, or its skin head), friendships, messages and the mod lists/files you share. While the launcher is open, your friends see you online.
friends.consentPrivate: Only you and the person you talk to can read your messages; only your friends can see your mod lists.
friends.consentDelete: "Turn off friends and delete my data" removes your friends data (profile, photo, friendships, messages, shared files) from the server at any time. Your account names stay reserved; deleting an account frees its name.
friends.shownAs: Friends see you as "{{name}}" (your selected account).
friends.requestSent: Request sent; they show up once they accept.
friends.noFriends: No friends yet. Share your code or enter a friend's code above.
friends.pickFriendHint: Choose a friend on the left to chat or browse the mods they share.
friends.messagePlaceholder: Write a message… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line)
friends.disable: Turn off friends and delete my data

confirm.removeBody: Messages are kept; becoming friends again needs a new request.
confirm.blockBody: They cannot send you requests or messages or see your mods. You can unblock later.
confirm.disableBody: Your profile, photo, friendships, messages and all shared files are deleted from the server for good. Your account names stay reserved.

mods.none: {{name}} has not shared any mods yet
mods.noneHint: Your friend can share an instance under "My shared instances" on the Friends page.
mods.noInstance: Create an instance first to install mods.
mods.mismatch: This list is for {{theirs}}; your instance differs, so mods may not work.
mods.conflicts: Skipped because a different file has the same name: {{files}}.
mods.unverifiedBody: {{count}} files are not on Modrinth; {{name}} uploaded them and nobody checked them. They run code on your PC — only install them from someone you trust.

shares.title: My shared instances
shares.hint: Your friends can see the mod list of a shared instance. Mods that are not on Modrinth are uploaded to the server (max 50 MB per file).

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Your favourite servers and each profile's in-game list, with live status, player count and ping.
servers.name: Name
servers.favoritesEmpty: No favourite servers yet. Use "Add server" or star a server from the game list.
servers.gameListEmpty: This profile's in-game list is empty.
servers.noInstances: Create a profile first to join servers.
servers.lockedWhileRunning: The game list cannot be changed while the game is running.
